title: Handoff E2E Verdict
description: The artifact an e2e_verifier job writes to .handoff/e2e/<jobId>/verdict.json. Structural validity is necessary but not sufficient: the contract is the set of cross-field rules in scripts/validate-verdict.py, which check a PASS against the exit code, the scenario counts, and the hash of the scenarios the driver reviewed. A verdict is a merge-decision input, so check it with that script rather than by shape alone.

result.description: PASS: every reviewed scenario ran and passed. FAIL: the product did not satisfy a scenario. BLOCKED: no valid execution happened, so nothing was proved either way. BLOCKED is never read as PASS.

base_commit.description: The immutable commit the worktree was cut from.

tested_commit.description: The commit actually under test, echoed back so the verdict names a commit rather than a branch.

scenarios_sha256.description: sha256 over the reviewed .feature files in path order. Must equal the hash the driver recorded at review time; a weakened scenario changes it and the run is rejected before its verdict is read. The lock covers .feature files only.

target.description: The approved system under test. A remote, production, destructive, or billable target requires explicit user authorization.

command.description: The exact command that executed the tests. Null only when BLOCKED stopped the run before execution.

exit_code.description: The runner's exit status. Null only when BLOCKED stopped the run before execution.

ids.description: Stable scenario ids (CHK-01 and so on) — the join key between the Gherkin scenarios and this verdict. Its length must equal total.

harness_edits.description: Every file the verifier repaired. Repairs are limited to launch and runner scaffolding; the driver diffs exactly these paths, which is what guards behavioural meaning living inside executable spec files rather than .feature files.

findings.description: What failed or blocked the run. A product failure is a finding routed back to the original implementer, never fixed by the verifier.

evidence.description: Paths to artifacts a human can inspect: videos, screenshots, runner logs.
